create.name: George Lizos
create.bio:
George Lizos is a Greek Cypriot spiritual teacher and author whose work centres on energy protection, intuition and a grounded, action-led approach to manifestation. Raised on Cyprus, he spent his late teens and early twenties studying energy work, psychic development, divination and past-life regression, and he also serves as a priest of the Hellenic Ethnic Religion, the revived tradition of the ancient Greek gods. Alongside his spiritual studies he holds degrees in geography, psychology and management. He left his previous job at the end of 2017 to teach full time.

He has written five books. Be The Guru and Lightworkers Gotta Work deal with self-reliance and finding a purpose; Protect Your Light sets out a step-by-step practice for clearing and shielding one's energy, including online; Secrets of Greek Mysticism presents the Greek deities from the standpoint of a practising believer; and Ancient Manifestation Secrets draws on Greek and Egyptian philosophy for its seven laws of manifestation. His teaching now runs mainly online, through a monthly community called the Energy Work Membership, a self-paced intuition course, a periodic practitioner training and private sessions, and he hosts the Energy Work podcast, which used to be called The Lit Up Lightworker.

books.title: Secrets of Greek Mysticism
books.author: George Lizos
books.description: An introduction to Hellenic polytheism written from the inside, presenting the Greek gods and goddesses as living deities rather than myths, with the beliefs and rituals that go with them.

books.title: Protect Your Light
books.author: George Lizos
books.description: A practical system for clearing, shielding and strengthening personal energy, with a foreword by Diana Cooper; it also covers protecting one's energy on social media.

books.title: Lightworkers Gotta Work
books.author: George Lizos
books.description: A handbook for spiritually minded people who want to find and act on a sense of purpose, working through fear and doubt to make practical change in the world.

courses.title: Energy Work Membership
courses.description: His online membership community for energy workers and empaths, with monthly teaching on clearing, protecting and working with energy and on manifestation.
courses.price: £22 GBP a month, or £237 GBP a year

courses.title: Intuition Mastery School®
courses.description: A self-paced online course in psychic and intuitive development, in five modules, with a certificate of completion and a members' group.

courses.title: The Next Chapter
courses.description: Three months of private mentoring for people who feel they have outgrown their current life and want to make a change, combining his intuitive work with coaching. He takes three clients at a time.

courses.title: Psychic Reading
courses.description: A private one-to-one psychic reading session booked through his site.
